item.title: Just Use Postgres for Durable Workflows
item.description:
📝 In a Postgres-backed durable workflows system, application servers directly communicate with Postgres to execute workflows instead of going through a central orchestrator. Replacing a central orchestrator with Postgres (or another database) makes durable workflows fundamentally simpler. ObservabilityWhen using Postgres-backed durable execution, workflows and their steps are checkpointed to Postgres tables.
🔗 Read more: https://www.dbos.dev/blog/postgres-is-all-you-need-for-durable-execution

item.title: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei are both walking back AI jobs apocalypse predictions
item.description:
📝 “I thought there would have been more impact on entry-level white-collar jobs being eliminated by now than has actually happened. A year ago, Altman told his brother Jack on the Uncapped podcast: “A lot of jobs will go away…we have always been really good at figuring out new things to do…I’m not a believer that that ever runs out. Tech leaders have been issuing their own predictions on the future of work for years, ranging from AI being able to automate most white-collar work within 18 months, according to Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s belief that AI will not have an impact on the number of jobs, but will instead create opportunities for efficiency that will benefit employees leaning into the technology.
🔗 Read more: https://fortune.com/2026/05/26/sam-altman-dario-amodei-walking-back-ai-jobs-apocalypse-prophecies-ipo/

item.title: Legislation Killed Would Have Effectively Blocked Police LPR, Including Flock
item.description:
